dedupe_keys.name: ccnr reflection paper act now on low water and effects on rhine navigation edition 3 0

description: Act now! is the reflection paper of the Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine on low water and its effects on Rhine navigation; edition 3.0 is dated 27 October 2023 and runs to 49 pages. It was written by the CCNR secretariat with contributors from waterway administrations (WSV, Rijkswaterstaat, De Vlaamse Waterweg), hydrology institutes (BfG, the Rhine Commission CHR, Deltares), ports, shipping and logistics companies, shippers such as BASF and thyssenkrupp, MARIN and WWF. Following workshops after the 2018 low water event and in January 2023 after the 2022 event, it explains why inland shipping has become more vulnerable (larger, deeper-draught vessels, just-in-time supply chains), reviews hydrology and climate projections, for instance that restrictions at the Kaub gauge could last more than two months a year on average by the end of the century, and sets out measures for fleet adaptation, infrastructure, logistics and storage, digital tools, funding and dialogue. Coverage: the Rhine corridor. Access: free PDF in English and other CCNR languages. Licence and cost: free, no open licence stated. Caveats: a consensus policy paper, not a dataset; figures come from cited studies. It supports climate adaptation and capacity planning scenarios for inland shipping. It relates to the UNCHAIN Mannheim low water case study and the BfG Rhine forecasts and climate flow projections in the catalogue.
